facts.fact: The US Commercial Service guide says the government's Digital Transformation Plan 2023-2028 (Plan Stratégique Numérique) aims to raise the digital sector's contribution to GDP by six percent by 2028; no cost is stated (guide published 4 August 2025).

systems.tiers: described as focused on telecommunications and digitising public services

note: PSN fact recorded with class empty: the guide's description (telecommunications and public services) neither shows nor rules out an economy-wide scope; 'established' names no act, so no standing fact.
